move: large purple toggle: knob squashes, slides and flips 180, X becomes check
how: A 260x140 lavender toggle sits centred with a label beneath and a hidden purple radial glow behind. Cursor arrives with power3.out in the first 17% of the 4s loop. Flip on at 0.9s (22%): the toggle dips scale 0.96 and rebounds with elastic.out(1,0.5); a purple gradient fill fades in and the background glow blooms to opacity 1 / scale 1.1 with power2.inOut over 0.7s; the knob stretches scaleX 1.25 / scaleY 0.9, slides 120px with power3.inOut over 0.5s while rotating 180deg, then relaxes with elastic.out(1,0.4); the X icon shrinks out and a purple check scales in with back.out(2); the label rolls from 'Dark mode off' to 'Dark mode on' with yPercent ±110. At 2.5s (62%) the whole sequence mirrors back to off and the cursor exits by 3.9s.
adapt: Change the two label strings, the purple gradient and glow tint, the icons, and the toggle size (knob travel D = width - knob - 20). Keep the 0.5s power3.inOut slide with the 180 rotation — it reads as the knob rolling.
port: mount(el, shot) builds glowbg, tog (fillp, knob with two icons), lbl (two spans) and cursor inside el. animate returns the timeline with flips at 0.225D and 0.625D, cursor legs at 0.25D / 0.65D, exit 0.825D. Label fromTo uses immediateRender:false; scope selectors to el; cursor offsets assume the toggle is at stage centre.
caveats: cursor coordinates are hand-estimated offsets from stage centre
